entities.summary: Borys Pavlovich Tereshchuk was a Ukrainian former volleyball player who competed for the Soviet Union in the 1968 Summer Olympics. He was born in Kyiv. In 1968, he was part of the Soviet team that won the gold medal in the Olympic tournament. He played eight matches.
